captions.detailed: A benchtop monocular microscope featuring a black rectangular base, a vertical grey yoke arm, a black square stage with silver slide clips, and a grey lamp housing underneath. The main optical tube is black with light grey collars, supporting a rotating nosepiece turret with multiple objectives below it. The stage assembly is designed to slide prismatically forward and backward on a lower guide rail, while a small lamp-access door on the side of the housing rotates on a vertical hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a benchtop monocular microscope with a black base, a vertical yoke support arm, a square stage assembly, and an optical tube. The stage should slide prismatically on a lower guide, the objective turret should rotate below the tube, and a side-mounted lamp-access door under the stage should rotate on a vertical hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a rounded Box primitive. Create the yoke arm using a combination of vertical and angled Cylinder primitives. Build the stage assembly from Box and Cylinder primitives to represent the guide rails, square stage, and slide clips. Model the optical tube and rotating objective turret below it using stacked Cylinder primitives. Finally, attach the lamp housing under the stage using Box primitives, adding a small hinged door on the side.
